title: Distant Voices, Still Lives
creator: Terence Davies
description: Director Terence Davies’s memory film of his own family in working-class Liverpool in the 1940s and 50s: a violent father, a patient mother, songs sung in pubs. It is slow. Davies grew up in Kensington, an inner-city district east of the centre.

title: Nowhere Boy
creator: Sam Taylor-Johnson
description: Teenage John Lennon caught between his strict Aunt Mimi and his lively mother Julia, until Julia was killed by a car in 1958. Mimi’s house, Mendips on Menlove Avenue, now belongs to the National Trust and can be visited on tours.

title: Good Ol’ Freda
creator: Ryan White
description: Freda Kelly was 17 when she became the Beatles’ secretary and ran their fan club for over a decade. Then she stayed in Liverpool, worked as a typist and said almost nothing for fifty years. She first saw them at the Cavern Club.

title: Of Time and the City
creator: Terence Davies
description: Terence Davies’s documentary about the Liverpool he grew up in and left, cut from archive film under his own spoken commentary, fond and bitter by turns. The Museum of Liverpool keeps a carriage from the Overhead Railway, the elevated dock line seen in it.

title: Boys from the Blackstuff
creator: Alan Bleasdale
description: Writer Alan Bleasdale’s five-part BBC drama about out-of-work tarmac layers in early-1980s Liverpool. Yosser Hughes’s plea “Gizza job” became a national catchphrase. The Royal Albert Dock, now museums and shops, was derelict when they filmed there.

title: Letter to Brezhnev
creator: Chris Bernard
description: Two young women from Kirkby, a 1950s overspill town just outside Liverpool, meet Soviet sailors on a night out, and one writes to Soviet leader Leonid Brezhnev to get back to hers. Written by Frank Clarke and made on a tiny budget.

title: Brookside
creator: Phil Redmond
description: Producer Phil Redmond’s soap opera launched with Channel 4 in 1982 and ran 21 years. It was shot in real houses on a new cul-de-sac in Croxteth Park, a suburban estate, and took on strikes, drugs and unemployment.

title: Hillsborough
creator: Daniel Gordon
description: Daniel Gordon’s documentary on the 1989 Hillsborough stadium crush in Sheffield and the families’ long fight to overturn the police version of events. The memorial to the dead stands beside Anfield, Liverpool FC’s stadium.
